lean.name: Deduction.ch_core
lean.note: Lean first moves each evaluation from $a_t/b$ to $x$, then estimates the character coefficient. It uses the prescribed average for kept characters nontrivial on $H$ and the exact coefficient $1$ for those trivial on $H$. For omitted characters the estimate contributes their norms at $x$ plus the movement error. A one-character estimate is summed over the top places and rearranged into the kept sum and its absolute-value error.
